A '''sonic drill''' was a type of tool used by [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] for repairing and modifying vehicles. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] technicians aboard the [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] were equipped with sonic drills.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
